title: Dropzone
summary: A drop target over a real file input: drag files in or click, with type, size and count checks, a list of accepted files with Remove, and a reason for each rejection. Files are submitted with the form.

props.name: accept
props.description: Accepted types: extensions, MIME types or type/* (like the accept attribute).

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: browseLabel
props.description: Shows a real button with this text inside the zone (for example "Choose files") that opens the file picker. It becomes the zone's keyboard stop, and the file input stays only as the click target. Empty (the default) draws no button: the whole zone opens the picker.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

slots.name: hint
slots.description: A hint under the title (types and limits).

slots.name: input
slots.description: An existing file input (a Blazor InputFile) that keeps doing the reading: the zone then only draws the target, and dropped files are placed in that input.

events.name: pk-files
events.detail: { count: number, rejectedCount: number, files: File[], rejected: { file: File, reason: string }[] }
events.description: Files were picked or dropped: those kept and those refused with a reason.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The real file input, invisible over the zone.

parts.name: browse
parts.description: The button that opens the file picker (only when browse-label is set).

parts.name: item-note
parts.description: A file size or rejection reason (dynamic).

methods.name: pick()
methods.description: Opens the file picker, for a button of the host's own, so no hidden native input is needed. Call it from a click or key handler (the browser requires a user gesture); it does nothing while disabled. With an input in the input slot it opens that input's picker.

a11y: A real focusable file input covers the zone, so the keyboard opens the picker and the zone shows the focus ring; the list is a polite live region; rejections are text (with the reason), not just red; each Remove button names its file. The whole zone is the tap target on a phone. With browse-label, a real button is the one keyboard stop (its name is its text followed by the zone label) and the file input leaves the tab order and the accessibility tree; the button is 44px tall on a touch screen and on a phone-width page.
